description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart showing the distribution of dataset items across different audio content types (speech, music, sound, and mixtures), with 7 slices in total. The slices are labeled with percentages: Speech is a medium lavender segment at about 29.4%; Mix-Sound-Speech is a very light lavender segment (label partially obscured) that appears to be roughly about 22%; Music is a light purple segment at about 20.6%; Sound is a very pale lavender segment at about 16.5%; Mix-Music-Speech is a darker purple segment at about 8.2%; Mix-Sound-Music-Speech is a thin light-purple slice called out near the top at about 2.4%; and Mix-Sound-Music is an even thinner slice called out near the top at about 1.1%. Percentage labels are printed on or near the slices (with leader lines for the two smallest top slices), there is no separate legend, and no slice appears exploded or otherwise emphasized beyond the darker coloring of the Mix-Music-Speech segment; the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the ring.
